🧠 *Finance Options*

Thank you for your inquiry. Our loan & insurance desk provides comprehensive support to simplify your vehicle purchase. Here are the key details:

• Partner Lenders: We work with HDFC, SBI, ICICI, Axis, and Bajaj Finance.
• Down Payment: Approximately 10–20%, depending on your financial profile.
• Pre-Approval Timeline: Typically processed within 24–48 hours.
• Required Documents:
– PAN Card & Aadhaar Card
– 3 months’ salary slips (or ITR if self-employed)
– 6 months’ bank statements
– A cancelled cheque

Our team will handle document verification, match you with the most suitable lender, and track your application through approval. Simply reply with your preferred financier or share your basic details to start the process. We’re here to ensure a smooth, transparent, and hassle-free financing experience!
